_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 8, HUG FOR STRANGER / TEL AVIV TAL. Tal: 'one with people speaking'. V2 = no zooms (LESSONS 80). V3 = children out (Tal: 'you need to blur the kids faces'): kids piling in -> the older man's kiss; Tal's answer ('I saw the world...') is now HEARD over three adult hugs because his own shot has five children standing round him; Mexico starts after the hug (a teenage girl passes at left before 97.1); 'Fine, fine, thank you. How are you?' dropped (a teenage boy and a boy in a kippah come into frame); the opening shot is framed x0-0.70 so the four children at frame right are out, and ends at 0.93 ('I would love a hug' lost: the camera pans and no static framing keeps Tal in and the children out); the boy behind the pink-shirt man is blurred on the render (blur-face.py, blur/rules-*.json). Shape: the ask ('Come give me a hug') -> the hug -> 'I love you, bro' / 'the world needs more love right now' -> the stranger asks why -> Tal: 'I saw the world right now is so divided. There's so much hate right now.' over hugs -> arms wide ('Come'), a woman runs in, slow-mo hug, 'You are so beautiful. Keep smiling.' -> the older man's kiss -> a tourist: 'Where are you from?' 'Mexico!' 'Viva Mexico!' -> a second stranger, unprompted: 'The world needs more love, bro. Keep spreading positivity.' -> the man in the beige shirt: 'How are you, my brother?' ... 'I love you.' 'Me too.' END. Natural sound, English speech; captions from the WhisperX-aligned transcript (tools/align-cache.py on 5676/5682/5683/5667), every used span read with a second engine (Groq large-v3 on the window) + RMS. 5682 30-43 alignment was wrong (Groq whole-second segments) and was re-timed by hand from two engines + RMS; see hand_fixed in that transcript. Cut out: 'my boy, chag sameach' x2 (holiday greeting), 'Never forget, we love you' (ambiguous), 'Yo soy de Miami'.
